idea.title: One layout field can carry slide design through a renderer
idea.summary: Seven personal carousel compositions were integrated through the existing Content Model layout field, adapter, typed renderer model, SlideRenderer, and shared canvas. The supplied catalog's separate template property stayed reference-only, avoiding a second renderer pipeline.

context.goal: Install reusable personal carousel layouts without generating React or CSS per post.
context.situation: The repository received a standalone seven-layout TSX/CSS reference while its renderer already had a workspace adapter, typed SlideData union, Studio, and two export paths.
context.problem: Copying the standalone renderer would duplicate the template selection field and rendering path, while the old Content Model layout IDs did not express the new compositions.
context.initial_thoughts: Reuse the current slide-level layout contract and treat the supplied components as design references.
context.investigation: Inspected the supplied types, catalog, example, TSX, CSS, active Content Model, Workflow 04, adapter, renderer, Studio, validation, and export routes. The supplied README also described the catalog as a reference rather than an app pipeline.
context.decision: Keep Content Model → adapter → typed renderer models → SlideRenderer → presentational layouts. Preserve legacy IDs, map final-cta to closing, and scope supplied warm-light styling to this personal account.
context.implementation: Added seven typed layouts, local workspace evidence mapping, layout-specific validation and Inspector editing, schema/workflow documentation, adapter tests, and a seven-slide fixture.
context.result: TypeScript and Vite production builds passed; five focused adapter/schema/validation tests passed. Browser checks confirmed all slides render at 1080×1080, the local screenshot loads, guides stay out of exports, and preview/client export/Playwright route markup matches.

learning_points: A structured layout field can carry a visual decision from authoring to rendering without inspecting post copy.
A supplied UI reference can be adapted through an existing architecture instead of installed as a parallel renderer.
Legacy layout mapping and legacy metadata preservation need explicit tests when changing the renderer model.
story_points: The supplied catalog had a separate template property, while the app already had a slide-level layout contract.
The seven compositions were adapted into the existing typed pipeline and shared slide canvas.
Studio preview, its export capture, and the Playwright route were checked against the same rendered markup.
possible_angles: A design reference does not need to become a second application architecture.
One explicit layout choice can drive both preview and export when every path shares the same renderer.
